capability.name: Documentos fiscales electrónicos
intents: determinar si un documento debe transmitirse electrónicamente
emitir una factura o nota al proveedor fiscal
consultar y reconciliar un resultado ambiguo
diagnosticar rechazo o fallo de transporte
habilitar ambiente emisor proveedor o tipo documental
evaluar cobertura fiscal de un país

dependencies: published country pack and clearance model
restrictions: BTW owns legal transformation signature CUFE and authority transmission under the current PO decision
UBP never invents a fiscal identifier or marks acceptance from transport success alone
ambiguous outcomes reconcile before any resend
credentials remain tenant and environment isolated and never appear in read APIs or logs
production emission fails closed without every authoritative prerequisite
provider failure does not erase or silently reverse the internal sale
each country and document type requires executable external evidence

deterministic: inspect fiscal applicability and transmission authorization
trace source document payload attempt response state and artifacts
classify rejection transport failure ambiguity and acceptance
verify provider environment issuer credentials and endpoint readiness
poDecision: approve a provider or direct authority connection
approve countries and document types offered commercially
change the UBP versus provider responsibility boundary
architectHandoff: new provider adapter or protocol version
reviewerGate: real provider test account contract evidence
source identity and legal number correlation
accepted result includes nonempty provider fiscal identifier
ambiguous outcome reconciles without blind duplicate POST
artifacts are linked and access controlled
no direct DIAN call or local CUFE generation under the current decision
forbiddenWithoutApproval: declare country or document type supported

retrieval.provenance: Electronic Fiscal Documents capability derived from UBP ADR-0013 and implementation at pinned UBP revision ebf1c845bdf917d821f3182bff0cbe04c21d2c8e. Country and document-type completeness remain blocked without real provider E2E evidence.
